content_html:
背景: 只有一个 gg 邮箱,之前注册 cc 被封了.账号当时也删除了.

今天登陆提示 "This email is already associated with another account or was used too recently."


weijie wu <[email protected]>
06:19 (2 分钟前)
发送至 support

Hello Anthropic Support,

I am unable to log in to my Claude account.

When I try to register or log in with my email address, I receive this message:

"This email is already associated with another account or was used too recently."

I would like to delete the existing Claude account associated with this email address so I can register again.

Email address: 脱敏邮箱

Please help me delete the account or release this email address.

Thank you.

不知道是否能通过,大家有成功过的没?
